extractions.value: The diagnosis in this patient was based on the clinical features of stimulus-sensitive and activity-induced painful muscle spasms in association with continuous motor unit activity seen on the EMG. The pattern of muscles involved was consistent with the stiff-limb syndrome described by Barker et al., and the response to diazepam strengthened the diagnosis.

extractions.value: Childhood onset at age 6. No myoclonus was ever noticed. Autonomic and sphincter function were normal. The trunk muscles were little affected. The patient was discharged on diazepam, able to perform activities of daily living with little discomfort.
extractions.quote: The most striking aspect of this patient is the onset at age 6, since most reports have been on adults. ... No myoclonus was ever noticed. ... Autonomic and sphincter function were normal. ... The trunk muscles were little affected. ... He was discharged on the same dose of diazepam, now able to perform activities of daily living with little discomfort.
